name: Soyuz TM-29
about: Soyuz TM-29 (1999-007A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STM), launched 1999 Feb 20. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1999 Mar 22), held fixed
docked to S16609; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
